center.scope: H(Z9) -> H(F3) reduction. Kernel order27, preimage of center C3² × C9. Minimal order729 among class-two 3-groups with an order9 commutator [a,b]: a,b independent mod center to order9 by commuting with b,a, center >=9. No proof of full anomaly extension or E6 embedding; 48 uniform-charge fields only representation of center, not of H27.

golay.scope: Constructive code-specific six-site syndrome pumping with uniform choice of check and one of six sites. Correct nonzero syndrome by local Pauli. Exact absorbing graph for each CSS syndrome sector; four independent sectors for two copies. No supplied stabilizer-free universal selector: permutation-invariant dynamics dark on all Golay states cannot have nontrivial jumps <=6 because some code has full-rank marginal on each given support.
